A real lazy-load address wins over an inline data src when the payload is not kept

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using System.Text.Json;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var ConfigOptions = new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true };
var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<p><img src=\"data:image/png;base64,AAAA\" data-src=\"https://example.com/real.png\" alt=\"icon\"></p>", new ConversionOptions { InlineDataMedia = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<InlineDataMedia>("\"DropElement\"", ConfigOptions)! });
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
```
